skill_name: Design a product given the specific requirements.
workflow: A smartwatch designed for low cost, easy use and high battery life should have a simple, stylish design. The body of the watch should be lightweight and feature a display that is easy to see in daylight. The buttons should be clearly labeled, intuitive and easy to press. To maximize battery life, the watch should feature a battery-saving mode for when it is not in use.
